notes.title: Stone Age: Digital Edition is a part of Turn-Based Carnival 2024! 🎲
notes.content:
Stone Age: Digital Edition is joining another exciting edition of the Turn-Based Carnival!

This event is a tribute to the games that make us think, plan, and savor every move. It's a chance to celebrate the creativity, depth, and diversity of turn-based gameplay. 👇

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34953556/96dad9192d8cbcd0dc58b95033113ed9362507dd.png

But that’s not all!

We have some exciting news to share! Alongside the Turn-Based Carnival, we are proud to announce our first original game - Inkborn, a roguelike deckbuilder that takes players on a dynamic, strategic journey unlike anything you've experienced before. Set to release on Early Access in Q2 2025! 🖋️

What sets Inkborn apart? 🃏
Inkborn features an innovative combo system where players discover powerful moves by playing cards in specific sequences, reminiscent of classic fighting game combos but with a unique twist. Our original Origami art style and evolving roster of character classes make every run feel unique. At launch, players can experiment with over 100 kinds of cards, and we'll be expanding the game with more characters, cards, and features leading up to the Full Release in Q2 2026. 🎮

Stay tuned for more updates, and prepare to embark on an unforgettable journey of intricate folds and strategic choices. Add Inkborn to your wishlist and follow to stay in the loop! 👇

notes.title: Add K2: Digital Edition To Your Wishlist!
notes.content:
We would like to proudly announce that we've become the official publishers of an exciting upcoming digital board game adaptation developed by our friends at Devon Games! 🤝

K2: Digital Edition brings the thrill of climbing K2 - Earth’s second-highest and one of the most dangerous mountains - right to your screen. Compete against AI with 3 difficulty levels, challenge your friends in real-time or asynchronous multiplayer, test your skills in a fast-paced single-player campaign or face the journey alone. 🧭 The game is easy to learn but hard to survive, offering a gripping and fun experience. Check the weather forecast regularly to adjust for freezing and severe conditions, and aim for the right weather window to set up your camp. 🏔️

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34953556/f88c6ce9fa31813e6f49935dea895fbae8e32ee2.png

Plus, the public demo is live on Steam - so you can get a taste of the challenge every day! Don’t miss out on the adventure - add it to your wishlist and be among the first to conquer K2’s deadly summit! 🥳

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2561310/K2_Digital_Edition/

notes.title: Stone Age: Digital Edition update 1.2.1 is here!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43548339/12db318ddea328cb3afe403780d3a4f2f2f4ca23.jpg

The v1.2.1 update is live! 🍖

Hello there!
We're excited to bring you a brand new update for Stone Age: Digital Edition! This time, we've focused on enhancing your experience in local multiplayer and have also made a small fix regarding localization.
Thank you for all your feedback - it has made it easier for us to improve the game. You are the best!
Now, let’s dive into the changelog! 👇

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43548339/c86b1341e13b03c35f655d722cdcda9c10ba375f.png

[Feature] Added a feature where players in a local multiplayer game must confirm that it is their turn.
[Fix] Resolved an issue where the game could become unresponsive during the 'Confirm End Game' phase if a local multiplayer game was loaded after the first player made their turn but didn't confirm it.
[Fix] Fixed incorrect button localizations for non-English languages.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43548339/472a3dff275f9452d15b5d46093944e3eb58cb62.png

That's it for today! 💪
Thank you for your feedback and support for Stone Age: Digital Edition. We hope you're having a blast playing the game. Don’t forget to follow us on X, Facebook, and join our Discord server!

notes.title: Stone Age: Digital Edition update 1.1.9 is here!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43548339/12db318ddea328cb3afe403780d3a4f2f2f4ca23.jpg

The v1.1.9 update is live! 🍖

The last few weeks have been truly special for Stone Age: Digital Edition. We've wrapped up our mobile beta tests and launched the game on iOS and Android! 📱 But we don't intend to slow down now. Based on users feedback, we've prepared a brand new update. 
Here's what you can expect! 👇

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43548339/f8ed9251dc7f21c6973710a81bb3351b04f96ead.jpg

[QoL] AI players are now easily distinguishable thanks to a newly introduced icon in the Final Scoring.
[QoL] Implemented minor visual adjustments to the cards panel for a cleaner and more intuitive interface.
[QoL] Improved the readability of Culture Symbols in the player's panel.
[QoL] Added the ability to skip animations for gaining production, tools, and workers.
[QoL] Improved the refreshing mechanism of tools in the player panel during the Collecting Workers phase.
[Fix] Addressed an issue where triggering the "Undo" action immediately after dice rolls led to animation glitches.
[Fix] Resolved rare occurrences where players could get stuck after skipping Collecting Workers phase animations.
[Fix] Fixed an issue where the window informing about another player leaving the online game was displayed incorrectly.
[Fix] Fixed a bug that caused incorrect highlighting of the player panel, improving interface clarity.
[Fix] Ensured that arrows in the tutorial window (accessible via the Menu) are now functioning correctly.
[Fix] Addressed stability issues on mobile devices to provide a more reliable experience across all platforms.
[Fix] Corrected the display of the Clay icon in building tooltips for accurate resource identification.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43548339/472a3dff275f9452d15b5d46093944e3eb58cb62.png

Tomorrow, Stone Age will premiere on the Nintendo Switch, aligning with the conclusion of the Pre-Order phase. 🎮

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43548339/277b19d6a18c279a9ddebcb70c6f0b5845a3fa13.png

We're excited to see the successes you'll achieve as you steer toward flourishing in the Stone Age!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43548339/1b17f3be82b3f53700d14fea410b82c66e78a160.png

notes.title: Stone Age: Digital Edition update 1.0.7 is here!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43548339/db9fc4b9aa22c394a63bba89894c69a27c28d72b.jpg

The update is here!

Today we have another patch for you! 
Grab your tools and meeples and jump into the updated Stone Age: Digital Edition.
Check out what changed:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43548339/77bbfba186304e8275a51840caf74da5c485d98d.jpg
[Feature] Now when buying a card that allows all other players to choose profit, the following confirm turn action is automatic, when we have no other workers on the board.
[Fix] Now you have to confirm, that you want to roll dice after you bought a card with "surprise benefit".
[Fix] The Hover animation while highlighting Hunting Grounds has been fixed.
[Fix] Localization in the card where the player can gain 2 stone goods has been fixed.
[Fix] Issue with login text wrapping while logging in has been fixed.
[Fix] Cards with "Gain two any goods" have been improved.
[Fix] Minor fixes to building tooltips.
[Fix] Issues with displaying tooltips under the ranking update have been fixed.

Have you heard about the starvation tactic?

I'm not gonna lie, I tried it once and it was awesome! 😃

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43548339/586643553c4d48d0fa2c780805b317513181c7ca.jpg

Each turn must end (after the feeding phase! - or not, as the strategy above suggests ^^) so that is all for today! :) Expect more updates soon! :) Let us know what you think of the game through the comment section or the feedback feature! (an envelope icon)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43548339/472a3dff275f9452d15b5d46093944e3eb58cb62.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43548339/1b17f3be82b3f53700d14fea410b82c66e78a160.png

notes.title: Stone Age: Digital Edition update 1.0.6 is here!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43548339/db9fc4b9aa22c394a63bba89894c69a27c28d72b.jpg

The update is here!

Today we have another patch for you! The updates are running through Steam like a pack of wild bison!   Check out what changed:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43548339/1ca3065b9e2c76bc2b56a517e15f8a7921d2c601.jpg

[Feature] In the Lobby, the room description now shows the nickname of an active player.
Not sure if it is your turn? Now you don't have to enter the room to check. The information will be displayed right in the lobby! 🤩

[Feature] Random avatars and colors can now be selected in local games.
Can't decide between blue or red today? 🤔 Want to play a new character but not sure which one to choose? Now you can let the game choose for you by choosing a random avatar and color!

[Fix] Replaced culture icons in player's panels for better visibility.
Information is power and we want you to have all information given to you as clearly as possible! That is why we are improving the visibility of culture icons even more in this update. 👀

[Fix] Fixed bug causing changing of the AI Difficulty in the online room to have no effect.
[Fix] Added information about a number of workers to the current player's panel.
[Fix] Information about QuickGame rooms in the lobby is now displayed properly.
[Fix] Issues of missing Hut animation have been fixed.
[Fix] Issues causing animations to be stuck have been fixed.
[Fix] The Issue causing the workers to not return from the Harbor right after purchasing the cards with dice rolling as a reward has been fixed.
[Fix] Placeholder time will no longer be displayed in the room description in the lobby, while the game has not started yet.
[Fix] Removed unnecessary popup that was showing up on the local player's timeout.
[Fix] Localization fixes. 
[Fix] Minor fixes for feeding phase AI animations.
[Fix] Minor fixes for gain goods and tools AI animations.
[Fix-Controller] Overall pad control on the board has been improved.

Buildings or Cards?

For me, it's the buildings - how about you? 🙂 Tell us in the comments!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43548339/dcb798ef653ff82203f6d2146b941dfee31625ff.jpg

Each turn must end (after the feeding phase!) so that is all for today! :) Expect more updates soon! :) Let us know what you think of the game through the comment section or the feedback feature! (an envelope icon)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43548339/472a3dff275f9452d15b5d46093944e3eb58cb62.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43548339/1b17f3be82b3f53700d14fea410b82c66e78a160.png

notes.title: Stone Age: Digital Edition update 1.0.5 is here!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43548339/db9fc4b9aa22c394a63bba89894c69a27c28d72b.jpg

The update is here!

Stone Age was a time of discovery! The situation could change with a single storm that would give our ancestors the fire they needed. (Of course, before they learned how to make fire themselves!)  We would like to show you the constant change of the Stone Age by releasing a new update! Check out what changed:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43548339/4ecde8b1ecbcd648f718734dc4b24bdfa9422244.jpg

[Fix] The Incorrect tool multiplier value from 2 cards has been corrected.
A tool strategy just got a little less powerful - as intended by the boardgame rules! :)

[Fix] Popup informing about "No rooms found" has been fixed.
[Fix] Fixed some visual bugs in the final scoring window.
[Fix] Fixed live scoring in online games.
[Fix] Issues of unwanted text and message wrapping have been fixed.
[Fix] Descriptions of cards have been fixed.
[Fix] Issues causing the locations in 2nd round to be hard to click on have been fixed.
[Fix] The Issue with clicking the confirm button after confirming the feeding phase has been fixed.
[Fix] Confirm and back button have been improved.

That is all for today! Expect more updates shortly! :) Let us know what you think of the game through the comment section or the feedback feature! (an envelope icon)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43548339/1b17f3be82b3f53700d14fea410b82c66e78a160.png

notes.title: Stone Age: Digital Edition update 1.0.4 is here!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43548339/db9fc4b9aa22c394a63bba89894c69a27c28d72b.jpg

The update is here!

Might not be as impactful as the discovery of 🔥 but still will greatly improve your Stone Age experience! ;) Check out what changed!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43548339/c6b6eb5a0d6307107e6557c2212bbee00aeadd0f.jpg

[Feature] Images for Culture Icons have been reworked in order to improve visibility.

You asked us about these a lot and we listened! From now on the Culture Icons will be more visible so that everyone will have 100% information about which and how many of each symbol they have! :)

[Fix] Visual errors in the Final Scoring window have been fixed.
[Fix] The Issue causing the last player in the 1st phase to be unable to send workers to more than one location has been fixed.
[Fix] The Live Game timer's size has been adjusted.
[Fix] Fixed localization issues with the Reset Password window.
[Fix] Glow of hunting grounds has been fixed.
[Fix] The Placement of the "No rooms found" notification has been adjusted.
[Fix] Issue causing the game to soft-lock after one of the players left the room has been fixed.
[Fix] The "Show/hide details" button on the Final Scoring window has been fixed.
[Fix] In online ranked games, Elo rating changes are now displayed correctly in the Final Scoring window.
[Fix] Opening user details in the room setup window have been fixed.
[Fix] The Clickability of league filter buttons in the lobby has been improved.

That is all for today! Expect more updates shortly! :) As your meeples are hungry for food at the end of the day we are hungry for your feedback! Let us know what you think of the game through the comment section or the feedback feature! (an envelope icon)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43548339/1b17f3be82b3f53700d14fea410b82c66e78a160.png

notes.title: Stone Age: Digital Edition update 1.0.3 is here!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43548339/db9fc4b9aa22c394a63bba89894c69a27c28d72b.jpg

The update is here!

Might not be as impactful as the discovery of 🔥 but still will greatly improve your Stone Age experience! ;) Check out what changed!

[Feature] "Waiting for opponent" hint has been added.
Not sure if it is your turn or what are you waiting for? Now you don't have to worry about such things because we added the hint informing that you are "Waiting for opponent". :) 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43548339/472a3dff275f9452d15b5d46093944e3eb58cb62.png

[Fix] Tooltips for buildings (on board) should now not be displayed over the user interface.
Last week we added the UI scaling slider and now we have improved this feature! Tooltips now will do what they are supposed to do and that is give you all the information you need to win! :D

[Fix] The Issue causing card info missing in the cards track minimized view (in the upper right corner of the screen) has been fixed.
[Fix] In online games the short room names will not be unnecessarily cut.
[Fix] Closing cards description after exiting the window is now working correctly.
[Fix] Tooltip of the icon describing a number of possessed building tiles is now correctly displayed.
[Fix] Issue causing the building cost on the board to be displayed incorrectly has been fixed.
[Fix] Live Scoring button has been graphically improved.
[Fix] The "Could not connect to server" message is now not constantly displayed while trying to change options in the account settings window.
[Fix] Scrolling the cross-promotion window by clicking on the arrows has been fixed.

That is all for today! Expect more updates shortly! :) As your meeples are hungry for food at the end of the day we are hungry for your feedback! Let us know what you think of the game through the comment section or the feedback feature! (an envelope icon)

notes.title: Stone Age: Digital Edition has been released!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43548339/89d321a72938963098c12aa390e11d378fe53145.png

Now you can play Stone Age: Digital Edition!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43548339/7a5dffa0feabaf9c6da9525bfeb3e8d1138990a6.jpg
Grab your meeples and get ready for some Stone Age because the Stone Age: Digital Edition has just dropped! :D We have so much prepared for you, the game is one thing but in case you didn't hear - we have matchmaking and ranking games right from the start! Keep reading for more info and gameplay snapshots!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2177570/Stone_Age_Digital_Edition/

How do you play Stone Age: Digital Edition?
The rules are simple! In Stone Age: Digital Edition the turn is divided into 3 steps:
Place your workers! - Decide what you need and send out your people to get it!
Collect your workers! - Build tools and buildings with the resources you gathered!
Feed your workers - There's nothing better than a well-deserved meal after a day's work!
Enough rules, let's see some gameplay!
Happy to show you! Below you can check out a few screenshots from the game!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43548339/5e9ba536dbd9fc43fead8ce2f372ab371fae96de.png
There is everything you need to live - wood, fresh water, and plenty of food! Perfect place for a Stone Age village!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43548339/2e9a4162c78eaa6bc09e93841443840155aa708a.png
Gathering resources is always more fun in a group! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43548339/15187d66e99057b744a08a9bee4392e7ada7373b.png
And what better way to spend these resources than cards? These are just a few of the options you can do in your turn!

Ranked games are on!
Feeling the spirit of competition? We've got you covered! :D In Stone Age: Digital Edition ranking multiplayer games are available right from the start! This means now! :D Hurry up and prove to be the Best Chieftain in Stone Age: Digital Edition!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43548339/41c932fdcde3f544fbb4c94356067daf068ec31f.png

Sounds good?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43548339/648bf4e97146c0175647f5ebdcbfcd75bab60e96.png

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2177570/Stone_Age_Digital_Edition/

That's all! Now go and lead your people through the Stone Age. Compete with each other, try new ways to play, and just enjoy Stone Age: Digital Edition - It's a special day - the release day! Let’s go play now!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43548339/1b17f3be82b3f53700d14fea410b82c66e78a160.png
